angle: It is a deliberately calculation-free map that distinguishes the discrete families only by the sampling setup that produces each one instead of evaluating any probability mass function.
angle_detail: Watch [01:43]-[03:06] first for the fixed-trials versus fixed-successes contrast between the binomial and the negative binomial families, then [04:48]-[06:05] for how the Poisson approximates the binomial when n is large and p is small. The framing statement at [00:01] warns that no calculations follow, so do not expect formulas, moments, or tables here, and note the negative binomial has no L07 node counterpart. Use this as a chooser before detail videos and skip it as a computation reference.
